snippet.title: StackOn – Official Demo Gameplay Trailer | Card-Stacking Town Builder
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and wishlist StackOn on Steam

StackOn is a card-based strategy game that combines card stacking, town building, resource management, and dungeon exploration.

Stack cards to gather resources, produce items, construct buildings, and develop your settlement. Craft equipment, assemble a party, venture into dangerous dungeons, battle enemies, and bring valuable loot back home to help your town grow.

Key features:
- Stack cards to gather, produce, and craft
- Build and expand your town on a floating island
- Develop new buildings and technologies
- Craft equipment and assemble an adventuring party
- Explore dungeons, fight enemies, and recover valuable loot
- Use your dungeon rewards to support and improve your settlement

StackOn is currently in development for Windows PC.
The free demo is available now on Steam.

Developed and published by IntoGames.

#StackOn #IndieGame #StrategyGame
